record_note: Written 2026-10-06, after the fact: this repo predates the record and was wired by hand from the kit (its gate is adapted rather than copied — bash, its own stages), so `revision` is not the exact copy point; it is the newest kit commit any recorded file was taken from (d888e29, the hook-tier fix). Kind is `retroactive` for that reason. It carries no `.ci.env.example` (its gate takes no .ci.env) and no gitignore-footprint probe; kit fixes it does not claim are REPORTED by the checker with the result of running the kit's probe against this gate. Rule that keeps this file true: a commit that edits a copied artifact updates its repo_sha256 in the same commit. **2026-10-06, probe re-sync:** the copy of tools/kit-probes/hook-tiers-agree.sh here was the one taken at d888e29. The probe gained two refinements while the fleet was ported -- it reads a full tier single-sourced as CI_DEFAULT_STAGES (four sibling repos spell it that way and have no list in their push hook at all), and it reads the gate's own --list before calling a stage a decoration, because JSOM's `coverage` is declared opt-in. Without them the probe reported those repos as having no tiers. The copy is the kit's current file, revision and adopted_fixes[hook-tiers-agree].from_revision both name 919006e, and every kit_sha256 is re-read at that copy point. **2026-10-06, card t_075c0a6f (KitCI fleet batch 2 of 3):** the gate is no longer a bash script. tools/ci.sh and the probes under tools/kit-probes/ are DELETED; the gate is the tracked gate.toml (14 stages, tiers fast/full) run by kit-ci, plus scripts/gate-env.sh, scripts/gate.sh and one scripts/<stage>.sh per stage — all of them this repo's own files, which is why none appears in files[] below. files[] loses tools/ci.sh and every tools/kit-probes/*.sh entry: the artifacts are gone, so no hash can describe them. The kit fixes those probes guarded move from adopted_fixes to declined_fixes — not because the fixes were declined, but because the artifact they CHECK no longer exists (each probe is written against a single bash gate file; measured against scripts/gate.sh, see INCIDENTS.md for the verdicts). The contracts did not go: each one has a named home, listed in INCIDENTS.md entry by entry. .githooks/pre-commit and .githooks/pre-push are RE-HASHED because this commit edits them: they now NAME a tier (--tier fast, and --tier full with CI_REQUIRE_CLEAN=1, the old --require-clean flag moved into the environment), and their branch for this repo's own tools/ci.sh is gone with that file. `revision` and every other entry are UNCHANGED: nothing here came from the kit, and being behind the kit is not a failure.
